foundation = "naome:zfc"
statement = forall(x, equal(x, x))
proof:

 p1 = generalization(p0, x)
 return p1

membership_identity.source:
foundation = "naome:zfc"
statement = forall(x, forall(y, implies(member(x, y), member(x, y))))
proof:
 p0 = simplification(member(x, y), member(x, y))
 p1 = simplification(member(x, y), implies(member(x, y), member(x, y)))
 p2 = frege(member(x, y), implies(member(x, y), member(x, y)), member(x, y))
 p3 = modus_ponens(p1, p2)
 p4 = modus_ponens(p0, p3)
 p5 = generalization(p4, y)
 p6 = generalization(p5, x)
 return p6
membership_identity.purpose: Allowed checked helper; no final target solution is exported.

equality_transport.source:
foundation = "naome:zfc"
statement = forall(x, forall(y, forall(z, implies(equal(x, y), implies(equal(x, z), equal(y, z))))))
proof:
 p0 = equality_substitution(x, y, equal(x, z))
 p1 = generalization(p0, z)
 p2 = generalization(p1, y)
 p3 = generalization(p2, x)
 return p3
equality_transport.purpose: Allowed checked helper; no final target solution is exported.
